lines.en: I make my way over to the maid cafe to hang out with Chika and then probably have sex with her because she essentially lets me do that whenever I want now.
lines.zh: 我前往女仆咖啡厅找 Chika，然后大概会跟她做爱——因为现在她基本上我想什么时候就什么时候。

lines.en: I'm not used to her working here yet. And I'm not sure if I'll ever get used to it as my first instinct when calling her is still to head over toward our old bench at the mall.
lines.zh: 我还没习惯她在这儿上班。而且我不确定自己会不会习惯——因为想找她时，我的第一反应还是往商场里我们那张旧长椅走。

lines.en: I have to take a different bus now. It's a shorter ride and, by all means, it should be a welcome change for me.
lines.zh: 现在我得换一趟公交。车程更短，按理说对我该是个可喜的变化。

lines.en: But something just feels wrong about all of it.
lines.zh: 但这一切总让我觉得哪里不对劲。

lines.en: Something feels wrong about her new job and her new hair and the new bus and the new everything and I just want my old new-life back.
lines.zh: 她的新工作、新发型、新公交、新的一切都让我觉得不对，我只想要回我那个旧的「新生活」。

lines.en: I have no reason to go to the mall anymore.
lines.zh: 我再也没有理由去商场了。

lines.en: Chika lets me use her employee discount because, as she puts it, I'm family.
lines.zh: Chika 让我用她的员工折扣，用她的话说，因为我是家人。

lines.en: I throw up in my mouth at the idea of ever accepting this but the taste doesn't mix with the eggs.
lines.zh: 光是想想接受这个，我就差点反胃到嘴里，不过那味道跟鸡蛋不搭。

lines.en: And I finish my meal regardless because it's the right thing to do.
lines.zh: 我还是把饭吃完了，因为这么做才对。

lines.en: And because if I make myself sick, I might want to fuck her less.
lines.zh: 也因为要是我把自己弄恶心了，也许就不太想干她了。
Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！
